concerns.text: Tasks T014/T015 implement data fetching from 'pushshift/reddit' (FR-001), but the Plan.md explicitly switches to the HuggingFace dataset 'jplu/tf-reddit-comments-2020'. This creates a semantic conflict where the task claims to satisfy FR-001 (pushshift) while the implementation plan mandates a different source, violating the data source constraint.

Task T033 implements an LMM formula with predictors 'thread_age', 'comment_count', and 'topic_pc1..3' and random effects '(1|thread_id)'. This contradicts FR-003 and US3 which mandate the formula 'prosocial_keyword_count ~ thread_type + thread_length + user_tenure + (1|subreddit) + (1|user_id)'. The task silently relaxes the required model structure and variable definitions.

Tasks T026c and T027 implement a 'Mock Gold Standard' for validation. While the Plan mentions simulation for CI, US2 and SC-002 explicitly require validation against a 'dual-blind human annotation sample'. The tasks replace the required human validation with a generated mock, failing to satisfy the acceptance criterion for measurement validity (Constitution Principle VI).

Tasks T013 and T013a introduce a 'pre-collection power analysis' and 'ICC citation generation' workflow with an abort gate if power < 80%. This workflow is entirely absent from the Spec and Plan, representing a silent addition of a blocking gate and scope creep that was not authorized by the requirements.

Task T016 implements 'NLTK word_tokenize and -token negation window' for classification. FR-001 and US1 specify a simple regex match '/(thank|help|support|care)/i' on the thread title. The task adds unnecessary complexity and logic (negation window) not requested in the specification, altering the definition of the independent variable.

Task T024 excludes 'help', 'support', 'charity' from the prosocial lexicon. However, FR-001 and US1 define the 'Prime' condition using exactly these words. Excluding them from the dependent variable (prosocial count) while using them to define the independent variable creates a logical contradiction and violates the measurement logic defined in the spec.
